## [1.22.2](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/compare/v1.22.1...v1.22.2) (2026-11-17)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **build.gradle.kts:** add back `implementation` build ([dbd0729](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/dbd07292517e38f6d1b1314cacf3f95e38a08409))
* **Postparty:** *all* clip types will have the 5s postparty bumper removed... hopefully. if not, edited clips DO WORK - add a sticker or even trim by half a second, bumper will be removed. ([6516835](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/6516835b80917982ea90311e1934bc3105fc4b45))
* **Postparty:** fix fingerprinting again. ([775dddd](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/775dddd3690f695dadf1472c6734fe3abfdbb553))

patches.name: Remove clip bumper
patches.description: Removes the ~5s Postparty logo bumper from all exports. Forces client-side transcoding so unedited clips re-encode instead of direct-saving the server-baked file, then nulls the bumper path in both ffmpeg command builders so the re-encode never appends it.

patches.name: Enable media sniffer
patches.description: Restores Pawxy's hidden video/media sniffer to the default tool menu. The toolbar builder excludes Tool$Action.SNIFFER from the default list; this patch removes that exclusion so the sniffer appears like any other tool.

patches.name: Rate-us popup
patches.description: Either removes the rate-us popup entirely, or rewrites its text. Rewrite mode changes the dialog title/body/buttons. Remove mode kills the trigger so the popup never appears.

options.description: Prevents the rate-us dialog from ever appearing. Off = rewrite mode (change text instead of removing).
Replaces rate_app_title and rate_head. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_request and rate_app_propose. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_rate_now. Only used if remove is off.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks Pawxy premium features (VPN servers, removes paywall and upsell badges).

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Forces TamperCheck.validateAppSignature to true. Patched builds are re-signed, so the app's three hardcoded certificate SHA-1 hashes no longer match.
